phase: v8 Phase 8 post-merge hotfix (v8-phase8.1): day-pick point-in-time research qualifies the day-pick selection authority itself (pk_day.surfaces, shared with pk_day.run; swing research uses picks_export's own masks); a research cutoff before the first history observation is an empty view (HISTORY_EMPTY / BEFORE_PIT_HISTORY), never a crash; the history writer records liquidity without whole-dollar rounding (v8.history/2) while the immutable v8.history/1 records keep their bytes and hashes and their rounded KNOWN liquidity never decides a threshold or a slippage tier (LIQUIDITY_PRECISION_UNQUALIFIED); a shadow-ledger STATUS file name must match its experiment id. Audit v8.audit/7, v8-phase8.1. Research and history only: no legacy output changes

base.note: production main after the Phase 8 merge (PR #19); its fixture golden is the Phase 8 golden

rules.NO_LEGACY_DELTA: The hotfix changes the history writer (v8.history/2), the research-only point-in-time view and cost model (v8.pit/2, v8.pit-cost/2, v8.pit-research/3 - its corrected day selection reads funding from observed settlements only), the shadow-ledger validator and the audit snapshot's history section (v8.audit/7). pk_day.py and picks_export.py are refactored so their selection masks are shared with the point-in-time research; their outputs are byte-identical (tests/test_v8_phase8_hotfix.py against frozen copies). No engine imports any of it. The universe, every identity state (v8.identity/4, config hash unchanged), discovery (v8.discovery/1), every strategy, threshold, gate, stop, target, sizing, ranking, Top-N and every published legacy file are byte-identical to the base.

not_allowed: any BASE -> HEAD difference at all in the legacy outputs, the universe, the DEX status, the notes, the identity states or the engines' decisions: the hotfix changes the audit snapshot under data/v8/ (its history section) only.
